specs.title: checkbox checked/indeterminate opt out of the OS palette (glyph stays legible)
text-input focus draws a real outline (box-shadow focus ring is stripped)
selected list row uses the system selection colors (tint would otherwise vanish)
elevation-only surfaces gain a border (box-shadow is stripped)
buttons are delineated by a border
paging current page uses the system selection color
calendar selected day keeps a visible filled disc (fill on ::before)
spinner up/down arrow icons stay visible (fill is foreground, not page bg)
combobox caret icon stays visible (unlayered fill beats the component rule)
selected list check keeps its baked box (icon-fill guard must not clobber it)
accordion selected tab uses the system selection color
datebox popup gains a border (box-shadow elevation is stripped)
confirmpopup gains a border and keeps its arrow (elevation + CSS-triangle beak)
focus ring on a SELECTED navbar item stays visible (Highlight-on-Highlight)
datebox timezone selector keeps its top gap from the calendar (spacing is a margin, mode-independent)
tablet.css is enabled on a mobile UA
button meets MD3 minimum touch target
textbox meets MD3 minimum touch target
combobox meets MD3 minimum touch target
datebox meets MD3 minimum touch target
matrix scrolls horizontally and inputs stay usable on a phone
the row-label column keeps its width on a phone (not collapsed to 0)
picker opens on-screen with a bounded scroll wheel
tapping the input lands the sheet flush (not below the fold)
